newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tranz Rail retires debt, sets new credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Tranz Rail retires debt, sets new credit facility.

text.p: Tranz Rail Holdings said on Friday it had retired all of its bank debt with the proceeds of a previously announced sale and leaseback of certain of its rolling stock.
The company said NZ$118 million of the sale proceeds were applied to pay bank debt and the related secured bank credit agreements were terminated.

It also said Tranz Rail Holdings had negotiated a new NZ$150 million multi-option unsecured bank credit facility which, subject to final bank approval, was expected to be effective in the first calendar quarter of 1997.

On December 19, Tranz Rail Holdings sold through its equipment finance subsidiary around 15 percent of its non-shunting locomotive fleet, and around nine percent of its wagon fleet, for approximately NZ$131.5 million.
The equipment was leased back for use by Tranz Rail Holding's operating subsidiary.
